description: Reported bug: an Attached unit that was engaged the whole phase got a SECOND pile-in when selected to fight. Only the Blade Champion's model is within Engagement Range of the Boyz; the Custodian Guard's own models trail behind in coherency. FightPhase._proceed_to_fight_moves measured just the bodyguard's own models, read the Attached unit as unengaged and granted the 12.06 Overrun fight's additional pile-in (the FightSequencer, which folds the components per 19.03, had already logged types: ["normal"]). Player path: both players pass the 12.02 Pile In step via the End Pile In button; P1 clicks 'Custodian Guard' in the Fight selection panel; the activation must go straight to the AttackAssignmentDialog — no PileInDialog, no overrun unit, no PILE_IN legal action. Setup-only privilege: P1's CP is zeroed so the Epic Challenge prompt does not interleave.

the bodyguard's OWN models are out of Engagement Range
the Leader's model is engaged, so the Attached unit is engaged (19.03)
no second pile-in offered on the activation
